definitions.gloss: power saving; low power consumption; energy efficiency
definitions.explanation: Refers to reduced electrical power usage, either as a feature of a device or as a mode of operation designed to consume less energy.

examples.japanese: {省電力|しょうでんりょく}⟦モード→モード：11596_moodo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}えた→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦チップ→チップ：11019_chippu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{省電力|しょうでんりょく}⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧になっている。
examples.english: This new chip has a power-efficient design.

examples.japanese: {省電力|しょうでんりょく}⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{替|か}えたら→買い替える：19456_kaikaeru⟧、⟦{電気代|でんきだい}→電気代：09543_denkidai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かなり→かなり：01149_kanari⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: After replacing the air conditioner with an energy-efficient type, the electricity bill went down considerably.

notes:
Formed from {省|しょう} (to conserve/reduce) + ⟦{電力|でんりょく}→電力：14609_denryoku⟧ (electric power). Widely used in technology, appliance marketing, and environmental discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {省電力|しょうでんりょく}⟦モード→モード：11596_moodo⟧: power-saving mode
- {省電力|しょうでんりょく}⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧: power-efficient design
- {省電力|しょうでんりょく}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧: making more energy-efficient
- {省電力|しょうでんりょく}⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧: energy-saving type

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {省エネ}: energy saving — broader term covering all forms of energy, not just electricity; more commonly used in everyday speech
- {低消費電力|ていしょうひでんりょく}: low power consumption — more technical, used in specifications
- ⟦{節電|せつでん}→節電：07136_setsuden⟧: electricity conservation — focuses on the act of saving electricity through behavior rather than device design
